# On The World Map

> > Comprehensive geographic reference providing detailed maps, location guides, and tourist information for cities, parks, campuses, and attractions across the United States.

On The World Map specializes in location-based cartographic resources, with extensive coverage of California cities including Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, and the Bay Area, as well as major metropolitan areas throughout the United States. The site offers city maps, campus guides, park trails, zoo layouts, and neighborhood tourist maps designed for visitors and residents seeking geographic orientation.

## Key Topics

- California cities and geography
- City location maps
- Tourist and visitor guides
- Downtown and neighborhood maps
- Campus maps (UC system, colleges)
- Zoo and park maps
- Hiking trails and outdoor recreation
- Transportation and road maps
- Los Angeles attractions
- San Diego area
- San Francisco Bay Area
- Florida destinations
- Major U.S. metropolitan areas
- Geographic reference materials

## Major California Cities

- [San Jose Maps | California, U.S. | Discover San Jose with Detailed Maps](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-jose): San Jose city maps including downtown, transit, and tourist attractions
- [Berkeley Map | California, U.S. | Discover Berkeley with Detailed Maps](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/berkeley): Berkeley city maps including downtown, neighborhoods, and marina areas
- [Palo Alto Map | California, U.S. | Discover Palo Alto and Stanford with Detailed Maps](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/palo-alto): Palo Alto maps featuring Stanford University and Silicon Valley area

## Los Angeles Area Maps

- [Griffith Park Map | Los Angeles](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/los-angeles/griffith-park-map.html): Griffith Park map with hiking trails and Hollywood Sign in Los Angeles
- [Exposition Park Map | Los Angeles](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/los-angeles/exposition-park-map.html): Exposition Park visitor map with museums and parking in Los Angeles
- [Chinatown Map | Los Angeles](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/los-angeles/la-chinatown-map.html): Los Angeles Chinatown neighborhood street and tourist map

## Central Coast California

- [New Monterey - Cannery Row Tourist Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/monterey/new-monterey-cannery-row-tourist-map.html): Cannery Row tourist map with attractions and parking in Monterey
- [Pismo Beach Area Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/pismo-beach/pismo-beach-area-map.html): Pismo Beach area road map in California
- [Pismo Beach Parks Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/pismo-beach/pismo-beach-parks-map.html): Pismo Beach parks and beach access map in California
- [Salinas Area Road Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/salinas/salinas-area-road-map.html): Salinas area road and highway map in California

## Campus and Educational Maps

- [University of California Santa Cruz Campus Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/santa-cruz/uc-santa-cruz-campus-map.html): UC Santa Cruz campus map in California
- [Santa Rosa Junior College Campus Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/santa-rosa/santa-rosa-junior-college-campus-map.html): Santa Rosa Junior College campus map in California

## Parks, Trails, and Zoos

- [Sacramento Zoo Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/sacramento/sacramento-zoo-map.html): Sacramento Zoo visitor map with attractions in California
- [Naples Zoo Map (Florida)](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/naples/naples-zoo-map.html): Naples Zoo visitor map and facility guide in Florida
- [Black Mountain Open Space Park Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-diego/black-mountain-open-space-park-map.html): Black Mountain Open Space Park trail map in San Diego, California
